plan: dermatology robustness: benefit of a second reader across all referral shares
status: exploratory robustness check (HIBA and PAD already opened under derm_lock_v1)
question: Does the matched-volume benefit of a second reader hold across referral shares, or only at the prevalence-based share (1.31 x prevalence)?
grid: referral share f from 0.20 to 0.90 in steps of 0.05 (15 values), each model and each pair referring the same share

pairs.all_pairs: every ordered pair of different architecture, all training-run combinations (the H1 definition)
pairs.strongest_partner: for each deployed model, the different-architecture partner with the highest internal validation AUC (from training_record.json), so the choice uses no test labels

measure: relative reduction in missed cases from the deployed model to the pair at the same share, pooled over pairs; patient-cluster bootstrap (1,000); report whether each interval excludes zero
reporting: one curve per outcome, with the prevalence-based share marked; the result is reported whatever it shows
